name: accomplishments
description: Teaches Claude to build the evidence record a performance review needs before the evidence is gone — a session hook that distils each transcript into a redacted digest of your own prompts before Claude Code's 30-day purge deletes it, keeping the decisions and discarding the tool output where the secrets live; a sweep that reconciles git, PR, and review history against the journal and interviews the gaps; and authoring that turns dated entries into a review, a promotion case, or resume bullets without inventing a number
